title: NI-LEGAL — certificare contemporană restantă, separată de NI-FIN
body:
# Restanțe juridico-documentare NI, separat de implementarea virtuală

Acest tracker conservă limitele celor85fișe deja integrate; nu închide NI-FIN, nu promovează ACTUAL și nu certifică jurisdicții juridice. Organizarea declarată din2023 este baza descriptivă autorizată pentru NI-FIN. Statutul juridic oficial MD și părinții ACTUAL rămân protejați. Verdictul privind un întreg poligon OSM este distinct de identitatea legală a unei localități.

Registru imuabil: https://github.com/ovidiudeica/reforma-teritoriala/blob/447f9bdbca5eb2869d107641a14398f7a273165e/docs/evidence/ni-jur-review-20261021/review.json
SHA256fișier: `2b841ec4ae59d42070bfb1d0db7f6b7ff317e345ed96a236357d941f4e2e07a3`.

Fiecare ID de mai jos păstrează cele trei verdicte din registrul conservat: control efectiv, apartenența juridică a întregului poligon și certificare documentară contemporană. Nu sunt rezultate noi de cercetare. Dovezile și cerințele individuale se găsesc în `remaining_evidence_requirements`, `contradictions` și `existing_individual_decisions` ale fiecărei fișe.

title: OSM ACTUAL: freshness STALE — 11 geometrii MD lipsă în refresh-ul 18 octombrie
body:
## Confirmare: sursa ACTUAL OSM a depășit pragul de prospețime

[Workflow programat 39405395203](https://github.com/ovidiudeica/reforma-teritoriala/actions/runs/39405395203), 2026-10-20T10:05:28.895Z, pe `main@1a6107594438d752e793df5dd57aed96272d4474`:
- `data/sources/osm-current.json`: `snapshot_at=2026-10-05T23:50:05.218Z`; vârstă **14.427 zile**, prag **14**, verdict veritabil **STALE**.
- SIRUTA **23.921/45 PASS**, CUATM **22.561/45 PASS**.
- Nu s-au schimbat sursele, pragurile sau verdictul.

## Cauza operațională: două refresh-uri săptămânale respinse

- [11 octombrie / run 38133862606](https://github.com/ovidiudeica/reforma-teritoriala/actions/runs/38133862606): Overpass HTTP 500/504 și timeout; fetch RO a refuzat dependența incompletă `node/140097206`.
- [18 octombrie / run 39113587430](https://github.com/ovidiudeica/reforma-teritoriala/actions/runs/39113587430): preluarea OSM în faza online a trecut, dar validarea offline a candidatului a refuzat **11 geometrii master MD lipsă**: `MD=2585` față de `2596`, `total master=5819` față de `5830` (nu sunt cele 5848 identități ACTUAL). Nu a fost promovat niciun candidat.

## Criterii de închidere

1. Determină **ID-urile individuale** și cauzele celor 11 geometrii lipsă, cu diff per-ID între candidatul online din 18 octombrie și snapshotul acceptat.
2. Construiește/remețiază numai în *candidat OSM separat*, cu surse originale, relații/way/node complete, versionare, hashuri, teste negative și dovezi topologice. Păstrează contractele fail-closed.
3. Execută testele complete ACTUAL source/provenance/topology/release, fără schimbări ale părinților MD, fără poligoane inventate, fără P9.1.
4. Obține aprobarea separată necesară pentru eventuala promovare a noului snapshot. Abia apoi reexecută monitorul, confirmă un **PASS real** și închide issue-ul.

**Interdicții:** nu ridica pragul de 14 zile, nu suprascrie manual `snapshot_at`, nu importa snapshotul P9 Geofabrik ca substitut și nu marca monitorul PASS înainte de publicarea unei surse OSM reale aprobate.

Investigația și sincronizarea GATE-003 sunt documentate separat în [PR #395](https://github.com/ovidiudeica/reforma-teritoriala/pull/395).

Bumps [actions/download-artifact](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact) from 5.0.0 to 8.0.2.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/download-artifact's releases.

v8.0.2

What's Changed

  • Update the readme by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#473
  • Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.
  • Update @​actions/artifact to 6.3.1 by @​tunc-d in actions/download-artifact#492
  • Prepare download-artifact v8.0.2 by @​tunc-d in actions/download-artifact#493

New Contributors

  • @​tunc-d made their first contribution in actions/download-artifact#492

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/compare/v8.0.1...v8.0.2

v8.0.1

What's Changed

  • Support for CJK characters in the artifact name by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#471
  • Add a regression test for artifact name + content-type mismatches by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#472

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/compare/v8...v8.0.1

v8.0.0

v8 - What's new

[!IMPORTANT] actions/download-artifact@v8 has been migrated to an ESM module. This should be transparent to the caller but forks might need to make significant changes.

[!IMPORTANT] Hash mismatches will now error by default. Users can override this behavior with a setting change (see below).

Direct downloads

To support direct uploads in actions/upload-artifact, the action will no longer attempt to unzip all downloaded files. Instead, the action checks the Content-Type header ahead of unzipping and skips non-zipped files. Callers wishing to download a zipped file as-is can also set the new skip-decompress parameter to true.

Enforced checks (breaking)

A previous release introduced digest checks on the download. If a download hash didn't match the expected hash from the server, the action would log a warning. Callers can now configure the behavior on mismatch with the digest-mismatch parameter. To be secure by default, we are now defaulting the behavior to error which will fail the workflow run.

ESM

To support new versions of the @actions/* packages, we've upgraded the package to ESM.

What's Changed

  • Don't attempt to un-zip non-zipped downloads by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#460
  • Add a setting to specify what to do on hash mismatch and default it to error by @​danwkennedy in actions/download-artifact#461

Bumps [actions/upload-artifact](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact) from 4.6.2 to 7.0.2.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/upload-artifact's releases.

v7.0.2

What's Changed

  • Improves artifact download retries when the service returns HTTP 429 (rate limiting), including honoring valid Retry-After headers.
  • Updates @​actions/artifact to v6.3.1.

New Contributors

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/compare/v7.0.1...v7.0.2

v7.0.1

What's Changed

  • Update the readme with direct upload details by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#795
  • Readme: bump all the example versions to v7 by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#796
  • Include changes in typespec/ts-http-runtime 0.3.5 by @​yacaovsnc in actions/upload-artifact#797

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/compare/v7...v7.0.1

v7.0.0

v7 What's new

Direct Uploads

Adds support for uploading single files directly (unzipped). Callers can set the new archive parameter to false to skip zipping the file during upload. Right now, we only support single files. The action will fail if the glob passed resolves to multiple files. The name parameter is also ignored with this setting. Instead, the name of the artifact will be the name of the uploaded file.

ESM

To support new versions of the @actions/* packages, we've upgraded the package to ESM.

What's Changed

  • Add proxy integration test by @​Link- in actions/upload-artifact#754
  • Upgrade the module to ESM and bump dependencies by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#762
  • Support direct file uploads by @​danwkennedy in actions/upload-artifact#764

New Contributors

  • @​Link- made their first contribution in actions/upload-artifact#754

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/compare/v6...v7.0.0

v6.0.0

v6 - What's new

[!IMPORTANT] actions/upload-artifact@v6 now runs on Node.js 24 (runs.using: node24) and requires a minimum Actions Runner version of 2.327.1. If you are using self-hosted runners, ensure they are updated before upgrading.

Node.js 24

This release updates the runtime to Node.js 24. v5 had preliminary support for Node.js 24, however this action was by default still running on Node.js 20. Now this action by default will run on Node.js 24.
